name: Sérsekszőlős (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Sérsekszőlős (a blue and green shield with a white lamb and a bunch of grapes, within a green wreath) above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sérsekszőlős arms with wreath and scroll
